title: It’s Always Yours to Do
fullTitle: Soul Snack #75: It’s Always Yours to Do
description: Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give. Enroll in Soul Themes Today . Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey.

In this powerful Soul Snack, Gary Zukav delivers one of the most liberating truths of the multisensory path: everything you are learning, everything you are working toward, and everything you are becoming is entirely yours to do.
The journey toward Authentic Power cannot be delegated or outsourced – not to a partner, a parent, or a teacher. It belongs to you alone.

Your incarnation is wholly your own. You are responsible for what you have created in it – and you create everything in it. When you recognize this, you reclaim the creative authority that fear-based thinking quietly steals from you every day.

The solution is both simple and transformative: while you cannot determine what your future holds, you can choose how you respond when emotions arise. That Responsible Choice is where Authentic Power is built.
